title: May I have a pie?
objectives: 会用 May I have ...? 礼貌地请求
能用 Sure / Here you are 回应

blocks.title: May I have a pie
blocks.content: A: May I have a pie? B: Sure. Here you are. A: Thank you. May I have ...? 比直接说要更有礼貌。

blocks.title: 和 please 的区别
blocks.content: Apples, please. 简单直接；May I have a pie? 更客气，对长辈、客人常用。

exercises.stem: 听一听，选出你听到的句子。
想要一块蛋糕，礼貌地问法是？
exercises.explanation: May I have ...? 是最礼貌的请求方式。

exercises.stem: 别人说 May I have a pie? 你要给他，该说什么？
exercises.explanation: Sure. Here you are. 是“当然，给你”。
